quote: On Representable Graphs (2008) by Kitaev and Pyatkin formalized the problem of finding a complete forbidden induced subgraph characterization for word-representable graphs
note: Word-representable graphs were first introduced in 2004 by Kitaev and Seif. The characterization problem in terms of forbidden subgraphs was formalized in the 2008 Kitaev-Pyatkin paper 'On Representable Graphs' published in Journal of Automata, Languages and Combinatorics, Vol. 13, Issue 1, pp. 45-54.
